meta.title: useEffect — an inline object dependency re-runs the effect every render

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: ObjectDepLoop has an effect that sets state. With an object dependency created during render, that effect keeps re-triggering itself. A safety cap (5) stops the demo; real code has no such cap and would loop forever.

annotations.label: New identity every render
annotations.detail: The dependency array compares by reference. Two objects with identical contents are still different values, so an object (or array or function) created inline is always "changed".

annotations.label: Effect that sets state
annotations.detail: An effect that updates state it indirectly depends on is a loop waiting to happen. The cap below only exists so this demo terminates.
